messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.32-10
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.32-10) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and CRAN.

There are no large changes: some small additions plus bug fixes.
See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

Karl Broman
